static.note: Static energy only; ZPE is separate.

gap.note: Total fixed-volume harmonic Helmholtz error; includes E₀, ZPE and thermal terms. RMS.

ordering.note: 284 non-degenerate pairs; |ΔF_DFT| ≥ 1 meV/atom.

envelope.note: Pairwise audit, not a scored multi-phase stable envelope.

entropy.note: Relative entropy score not exported for the full audit.

cancellation.note: Descriptive cancellation statistic, not a pass score.

coupling.note: Anchor includes ΔE₀ and ΔZPE; correlation is descriptive.

hvp.note: No matched HVP/IFC error exported; DFT phonon references exist.

risk.note: α is a threshold parameter, not a selective-risk guarantee.

spectral.note: Ideal MSE removal under sorted spectral matching, not achievable training gain or a validated physical mode match.

workflow.note: No matched metric reported.
